# Expenses made in the trip to Santorini

data.title: Tokyo Trip Expenses
data.content:
# Tokyo Trip Expenses
- Timothy paid $250 for "Airbnb Stay". Owed equally by Timothy, Michael, Norman and Brandon.
- Brandon paid $150 for "Train Tickets". Owed equally by Kevin, Michael, Norman, Brandon and Timothy.
- Kevin paid $400 for "Cabin Rental". Owed equally by Norman, Brandon, Timothy, Kevin and Michael.

data.title: Expenditures of Venice trip.
data.content:
# Expenditures of Venice trip.
- Kristin paid $200 for "Night Out". Owed equally by Jeremy and Kristin.
- Jeremy paid $80 for "Snorkeling Gear". Owed equally by Jeremy and Kristin.
- Matthew paid $600 for "Cruise Tickets". Owed equally by Jeremy, Matthew and Kristin.

data.title: Seoul Trip Expenses
data.content:
# Seoul Trip Expenses
- Morgan paid $120 for "Ziplining". Owed equally by Kristin, Morgan and Cory.
- Morgan paid $250 for "Paragliding". Owed equally by Kristin and Cory.
- Kristin paid $100 for "Golfing". Owed equally by Morgan, Cory and Kristin.
- Cory paid $300 for "Vacation Photography". Owed equally by Morgan, Kristin and Cory.

data.title: Expenditures of Cairo trip.
data.content:
# Expenditures of Cairo trip.
- Katherine paid $75 for "City Tour". Owed equally by Katherine and Cory.
- Cory paid $350 for "Safari Tour". Owed equally by Matthew, Jeremy, Katherine, Katie, Cory and Morgan.
- Cory paid $400 for "Hot Air Balloon Ride". Owed equally by Jeremy, Morgan and Katie.
- Katie paid $180 for "Surfing Lessons". Owed equally by Katherine, Katie, Matthew, Jeremy, Morgan and Cory.
